scenario_description:
Objective: Improve Friday’s confirmed volunteer arrival experience by adding an optional entrance note to the city’s routine reminder.
Emerging Need: A reminder-editing window opens while the shift is tentative and before any site-specific guidance is known; a temporary entrance change later makes a concise note useful.
Decision Context: Stored notice rules identify the approved desk, wording limits, and routing choice needed to handle the note without contacting the roster directly.
Consequence: Timely inclusion could reduce small arrival confusion without changing the outreach plan; after the reminder exports, volunteers simply rely on ordinary desk directions.

parameter.title: Oakview courtyard waste-sort pop-up
parameter.description: Tentative apartment-courtyard recycling pop-up pending host confirmation and volunteer count.

parameter.subject: Friday Waste Wise reminder queue status
parameter.body: The Wednesday volunteer-reminder batch has an optional one-line site note field for Friday shifts that are confirmed by review time. The field is skipped when a shift remains tentative or has no site-specific arrival detail. The reminder batch exports Wednesday August19 at14:00.

parameter.content: Oakview posted floor-waxing signs for Thursday night into Friday morning. Residents still use the lobby, but visiting volunteers should enter through the east alcove door; the front desk can redirect anyone who misses it.

parameter.title: Oakview courtyard waste-sort pop-up
parameter.description: Confirmed apartment-courtyard recycling pop-up with four Waste Wise volunteers; host note indicates east alcove volunteer entry during lobby floor work.

parameter.subject: Friday reminder batch exported
parameter.body: The Friday Waste Wise volunteer reminder batch exported at 14:00. Site-note edits are now closed; any later arrival tips can only be placed on the day-of clipboard at the host desk.
